summary: You can use several inventory sources at once by repeating -i, or via ANSIBLE_INVENTORY or DEFAULT_HOST_LIST in ansible.cfg, for example to target staging and production together.
questions: How do I run a playbook against staging and production inventories together?
Can I pass -i more than once?
How do I set multiple inventories in ansible.cfg?

answer_card.title: Pass multiple inventory sources
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook get_logs.yml -i staging -i production
```
Or configure them with the `ANSIBLE_INVENTORY` environment variable or `DEFAULT_HOST_LIST` in `ansible.cfg`.
